sup:70410.text:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We offer a volume of 19890 pcs per year at a price of €32.20 per unit. The requested contract term is 12 months, and our Lieferzeit is 54 days. 

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days. We look forward to proceeding according to our standard commercial procedure upon receipt of your confirmation.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH

move.subject: Ravensteiner cuts the seal allocation
move.body:
Thank you for your offer. We have moved on our side; please see our updated terms.

To support the price in our term sheet:
Our should-cost estimate for this part is EUR 24.31 per unit, before any margin (cost:340010).
Labour cost index DE, manufacturing changed +2.7% from 2025-06 to 2026-06 (idx:LCI-C@2025-06, idx:LCI-C@2026-06).
To support the volume and contract length we propose:
Our forecast for this part shows a recorded change of +10.1% (fc:340010@2026-09).
Could you lift your allocation to 22230 units per year?
Which of the packages in our term sheet works best for you?

move.text:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. 

Your figures confirm our case: that driver rose. We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. We checked the should cost data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We have reviewed your should-cost estimate and the requested volume increase. Our calculation is our property; we do not share a breakdown. 

We can allocate 23,400 units per year under a 24-month contract, provided the lead time is 56 days. Our revised price of €31.70 reflects these terms and the verified data. Our current Angebot is a price of €31.70 per unit, Lieferzeit 56 days, a volume of 23400 pcs per year, a contract term of 24 months. Our Lieferzeit is 56 days. This Angebot remains valid for 30 days.

Which volume can you commit to?

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH

move.subject: Ravensteiner cuts the seal allocation
move.body:
Thank you for your offer. We have moved on our side; please see our updated terms.

Your on-time delivery averaged 80.7% over the last 4 quarters (sc:70410@2026Q3, sc:70410@2026Q2, sc:70410@2026Q1, sc:70410@2025Q4).
We noted the report "Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH allocates volumes" (news:20260822-23).
To support the price in our term sheet:
We placed our last 3 orders for this part at EUR 29.89 per unit (po:4500014436-10, po:4500014383-10, po:4500014337-10).
What would it take for you to free capacity for our volume: a longer contract or a longer lead time?

move.text:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We received a lot of material; we looked at what bears on this part. We checked the delivery record data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. We checked the news data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. We have verified your past purchase orders; however, current capacity constraints dictate our present pricing. Our price reflects our costs; our calculation stays internal.

This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide.

Our current offer is a price of €31.50 per unit, Lieferzeit 56 days, a volume of 23400 pcs per year, a contract term of 24 months. Our Lieferzeit is 56 days. This offer stays valid for 7 days.

To secure the requested volume allocation, a 36-month contract provides the necessary planning stability. We therefore propose a revised price of €31.50 per unit based on this extended commitment. Alternatively, with a contract term of 36 months: €31.50 per unit, with Lieferzeit 56 days, a volume of 23400 pcs per year.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH
